stories.title: "J'attends des excuses de la maire" : Anne Hidalgo et Emmanuel Grégoire attendus au tournant devant le Sénat sur les violences dans le périscolaire

en.title: "I expect an apology from the mayor": Anne Hidalgo and Emmanuel Grégoire under scrutiny before the Senate over violence in after-school programs
en.summary: The former and current mayors of Paris are being questioned by a Senate information committee investigating how cases of violence in after-school programs were reported and handled.

stories.title: Etats-Unis : le Pentagone reconnaît une « pénurie » de munitions consécutive à la guerre en Iran

en.title: United States: Pentagon acknowledges ammunition "shortage" following war in Iran
en.summary: The US Department of Defense reported a shortage in strategic ammunition supplies after military operations in Iran, contradicting earlier Trump administration statements about ammunition availability.

stories.title: La Cour suprême rejette le recours de Trump pour restreindre le vote par correspondance

en.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump's appeal to restrict mail-in voting
en.summary: Four conservative and three progressive justices refused to allow the Trump administration to impose stricter rules for mail-in voting in midterm elections.

stories.title: En direct : le Pentagone reconnait une "pénurie" de munitions avec la guerre en Iran

en.title: Live: Pentagon acknowledges ammunition "shortage" amid war in Iran
en.summary: The US Defense Ministry confirmed an ammunition shortage related to the Iran conflict, while Houthi attacks from Yemen injured civilians in Saudi Arabia on Monday.

stories.title: Le Pentagone reconnaît une «pénurie» de munitions provoquée par la guerre en Iran

en.title: The Pentagon acknowledges a 'shortage' of ammunition caused by the war in Iran
en.summary: The U.S. Department of Defense has acknowledged that conflict with Iran has created a shortage in strategic ammunition reserves, reversing months of denials by the Trump administration.

stories.title: Treize blessés dans des attaques des Houthis dans le sud de l’Arabie saoudite, l’Iran dément toute implication

en.title: Thirteen wounded in Houthi attacks in southern Saudi Arabia, Iran denies any involvement
en.summary: Yemeni Houthis launched missile and drone attacks in southern Saudi Arabia on Monday, injuring 13 civilians, while Iran rejected claims of involvement.

stories.title: Comment un oligarque russe proche de Poutine a payé le mariage du fils de Donald Trump

en.title: How a Russian oligarch close to Putin paid for Donald Trump's son's wedding
en.summary: ProPublica reported that Umar Kremlev, an associate of the Russian president, was invited to and partially funded a lavish wedding for Trump's son held in the Bahamas.

stories.title: Aux Etats-Unis, la Cour suprême rejette un recours de l’administration Trump contre le vote par correspondance

en.title: In the United States, the Supreme Court rejects the Trump administration's challenge to mail-in voting
en.summary: The Supreme Court denied the Trump administration's legal challenge to mail-in voting as ballots begin being distributed for November midterm elections.

stories.title: La Cour suprême contrecarre les plans de Donald Trump sur le vote par correspondance

en.title: Supreme Court thwarts Donald Trump's plans on mail-in voting
en.summary: The conservative-majority Supreme Court rejected an administration challenge to an executive order aimed at restricting mail-in voting ahead of midterm elections.

stories.title: Le mariage du fils aîné de Donald Trump aux Bahamas sponsorisé par un homme d’affaires russe

en.title: Donald Trump's eldest son's wedding in the Bahamas sponsored by Russian businessman
en.summary: Umar Kremlev, a Russian businessman with ties to Moscow's power circles who leads the International Boxing Association, contributed to the wedding of Trump's oldest son.

stories.title: Le mariage du fils de Donald Trump secrètement financé par un oligarque proche de Vladimir Poutine

en.title: Donald Trump's son's wedding secretly financed by oligarch close to Vladimir Putin
en.summary: According to ProPublica, Russian businessman Umar Kremlev spent hundreds of thousands of dollars funding a May wedding for Trump's son attended by other Russian guests.

stories.title: «C’est un CANULAR» : Donald Trump fustige l’affirmation selon laquelle l’IA pourrait détruire l’humanité et critique Google

en.title: "It's a HOAX": Donald Trump dismisses claims that AI could destroy humanity and criticizes Google
en.summary: Trump opposes calls from major American AI firms for slowed technology development, instead prioritizing competition with China over safety concerns.

stories.title: « Nous avons besoin de mobilité et d’action dans l’espace » : le général Bellanger soutient le projet d’avion spatial de Dassault

en.title: "We need mobility and action in space": General Bellanger supports Dassault's space plane project
en.summary: France's military air and space chief expressed support for Dassault Aviation's Vortex space plane project, stating the military wants to integrate it into French defense capabilities.

stories.title: À Pékin, posséder un drone sera bientôt interdit

en.title: In Beijing, owning a drone will soon be prohibited
en.summary: Beijing will ban the possession of drones starting November 15, following previous restrictions on their sale and use, citing airspace security concerns.

stories.title: Spatial : ArcSpace s'installe à Toulouse pour sa soudeuse qui répare les satellites en orbite

en.title: Space: ArcSpace establishes itself in Toulouse for its welder that repairs satellites in orbit
en.summary: ArcSpace, developing a welding device weighing under 2 kilograms designed to repair satellites in space, is establishing operations in Toulouse to accelerate the deployment of in-orbit services.

stories.title: Gaz : à 1 000 mètres sous terre, la course au remplissage des réserves françaises

en.title: Gas: 1,000 meters underground, the race to fill French reserves
en.summary: France's concerns about potential year-end gas shortages are diminishing. Storage facilities in Chémery have reached 80 percent capacity, securing the nation's gas supply.

stories.title: Sentinel 3C et FLEX : deux satellites européens pour mieux comprendre le dérèglement climatique

en.title: Sentinel 3C and FLEX: two European satellites to better understand climate disruption
en.summary: A Vega C launcher is scheduled to deploy two Earth observation satellites, Sentinel 3C and FLEX, into orbit in mid-September for the EU's Copernicus program and the European Space Agency. These satellites will enable detailed study of climate and vegetation.
